objective: Add a versioned diagnostic assessment of DR24 epoch quality while preserving every raw epoch and keeping the assessment separate from model-input acceptance.

previous_knowledge_consumed.source: IRSA ZTF DR24 release notes, section 13.6
previous_knowledge_consumed.detail: DR24 documents catflags bit 15 (32768), HMJD, native magnitudes, clrcoeff and magerr caveats.
The official tutorial demonstrates catflags == 0 for strict clean-epoch plotting.
Bounded 1–10 OID raw endpoint; this branch is stacked on its head.

expected_improvement: Provide per-epoch and aggregate DR24 QC diagnostics
Keep likely-usable and strict-clean flag interpretations separate
Preserve raw epoch values and ordering
Explicitly prevent diagnostic QC from being mistaken for production model-input selection

raw_preservation.before: Raw DR24 epochs were returned without a versioned QC assessment.
raw_preservation.after: Service adds a separate qc_assessments collection; deterministic regression test checks raw epochs remain unchanged.

qc_coverage.before: No shared DR24 QC assessment schema existed.
qc_coverage.after: Versioned policy reports catflags bit 15, strict catflags==0, finite time/magnitude/error, negative magerr and provisional candidate counts.

scientific_validity.reason: The QC policy is explicitly diagnostic and is not approved for feature generation or model inference.

measurement.trade_off: The assessment adds a separate diagnostic payload and does not reduce raw data. It deliberately avoids selecting or deleting epochs.

evidence: Pure-function tests cover strict/likely-usable distinction, missing and invalid values, negative magerr, optional clrcoeff and raw immutability.
ObservationService integration test verifies that QC is attached separately from raw epochs.
CI for this branch is pending.

root_causes: Raw explorer previously exposed descriptive counts only; no reusable versioned server-side QC assessment existed.
unresolved: Color correction, calibration systematics and time handling remain unresolved.

findings: catflags==0 is the strict clean-epoch condition shown in the official HATS tutorial.
The DR24 documentation identifies bit 15 (32768) as cloud/moon-related; absence of this bit is a likely-usable diagnostic, not a clean-epoch guarantee.
Negative magerr is invalid; other photometric uncertainty components are not included in magerr.
QC diagnostics must not mutate raw epoch records.

open_blockers: Run full CI on the current branch head.
Compare policy classifications against independent source examples and representative edge cases.
Do not connect provisional candidates to v0.2 feature generation or inference without a separate accepted scientific contract.

knowledge_carried_forward: API returns separate qc_assessments keyed by OID; records[].epochs remain raw.
